mca_status: Active (listed on BSE, code 522183; no strike-off/liquidation/insolvency indication found)
revenue_source: Screener.in company page for BSE:522183 (ITL Industries Ltd), consolidated annual P&L: FY2024-25 sales Rs 183 cr, FY2025-26 sales Rs 203 cr; standalone FY25 183 cr / FY26 203 cr. Figures are from the company's filed audited results as aggregated by Screener; the audited PDF itself was not opened in this session.
note: Legal entity confirmed as ITL Industries Limited, a BSE-listed public limited company (BSE: 522183, NSE symbol ITL), registered office and works at 111, Sector-B, Sanwer Road Industrial Area, Indore-452015, Madhya Pradesh (source: itl.co.in/contact/). Screener.in states the company was incorporated in 1985 and is engaged in manufacturing of machines and machine parts plus trading business; it manufactures band saw and circular saw machinery and blades and is an authorised distributor for Eaton hydraulic systems and Siemens India - hence role manufacturer_trader. The other names in the input (Indtools Sales & Services, H&S Innovation, Indore Saws & Tools, Esupply World) appear on itl.co.in as divisions/brands/trading arms of ITL Industries Ltd, not as separately verified legal entities; 'Impress Marketing and Services' was not found on the company site and is unverified. CIN, PAN and GSTIN could not be retrieved: searx web_search was down (connection refused) and registry aggregators (zaubacorp, thecompanycheck, moneycontrol) returned HTTP 403; MCA/GST portals were not reachable with the available tools. These fields are therefore null, not invented. State claimed in the input was empty; registered state is Madhya Pradesh. Declared HS codes 820220/820231 (saw blades), 820810 (knives/cutting blades) and 845710 (machining centres) are broadly consistent with the company's saw-machinery and blade business, but HS verification is outside this role's scope. No rejection grounds: entity exists and is listed/active.
